policies.policy_name: Mandatory fields validation for incident update
policies.description: Any incident update must include all fields that are mandatory for the operation before calling update_incident.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.policy_name: Role‑based access control for incident updates
policies.description: Only users with the appropriate role may update an incident: Administrators, Managers and Agents have full CRUD on incidents; Reporters may update only incidents they originally submitted.
references: | Administrator (admin) | System Configuration & Integrity | Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) access across all tables. |

| Manager (manager) | Supervision, Escalation, Approvals | Full CRUD on operational tables (incident, problem, change, knowledge); READ access to all the tables. Can reassign incidents/requests. Can approve/reject Change Requests. Monitors SLAs and escalations. |

| Agent (agent) | Frontline Incident/Request fulfillment | Full CRUD on Incidents, Service Requests, Tasks, Work Notes, CMDB, Change, Problem, and Knowledge. READ access to all the tables. Can update assignment, state, and resolution. | Cannot bypass approvals, or change system administration settings. |

| Reporter (reporter) | IT Service Consumption | Can view and update their own submitted Incidents/Requests. Can search Public Knowledge articles. | Cannot view or modify records opened by other users, CMDB, or internal work notes. |

policies.policy_name: Assignment user must be active Agent or Manager and member of assignment group
policies.description: When the assigned_to field (or assignment_group) is updated, the target user must be active, hold the Agent or Manager role, and belong to the specified assignment group.
references: Constraints: assigned_to must be an active user with the Agent or Manager role and must be a member of the specified assignment_group.

policies.description: The new incident status must follow the allowed state transition matrix before invoking update_incident.

policies.policy_name: Resolution fields required for resolved state
policies.description: If the incident status is being set to resolved, both resolution_code and resolution_notes must be supplied.
references: Resolution Requirement: An Incident cannot transition to resolved without mandatory fields: resolution_code, and resolution_notes (free-form text, max 2000 chars).

policies.policy_name: SLA pause requirement when incident is on hold
policies.description: When status is changed to on_hold, the on_hold_reason must be one of the allowed enumerations and the SLA timer must be set to paused.
references: SLA Pause: The SLA timer must be paused (stage = paused) when the Incident is in stage = on_hold and the on_hold_reason is one of the following enumerations: Awaiting Change, Awaiting Caller, or Awaiting Problem.

policies.description: Any user referenced in the assigned_to field must have users.active = true.
references: User Status: Ensure any user being assigned to (assigned_to) or updated is users.active = true.

policies.policy_name: Referential integrity before closing an incident
policies.description: Before changing an incident’s status to closed, verify that all mandatory dependent records (e.g., resolution notes, linked problem/change) are satisfied.
references: Referential Integrity: Before closing any record, verify that all mandatory dependencies are satisfied.
